summary: Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (auth PIN, specialists CRUD, services CRUD, appointments create/conflict/outside-hours/date-filter/week-filter/status-patch/delete). Frontend: PIN screen loads with all testids, wrong PIN shows error, correct PIN 1234 navigates to /agenda which correctly shows 5 seeded appointments (Ana Castro, María González, etc.) with timeline. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Protected-route auth guard has a race condition — authed defaults to false and sessionStorage is only read in useEffect AFTER first render, so any direct URL navigation or page refresh redirects the user to PIN screen even when already authenticated. This blocks direct access to /semana, /nueva-cita, /catalogo.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: on full page load, `authed` useState is initialized to false; Protected redirects to / before useEffect reads sessionStorage('clinic_authed'). Refreshing /agenda or navigating directly to /semana, /nueva-cita, /catalogo kicks the user back to PIN screen.
No data-testid on logout button (requirement says all interactive elements should have data-testid). Could not locate via [data-testid="logout-button"].

integration_issues.flow: Direct URL navigation to protected routes after login
integration_issues.issue: All of /semana, /nueva-cita, /catalogo redirected to / (PIN) despite successful PIN entry in same tab/session — due to the AuthContext race condition above. In-app sidebar navigation (click) works because React state is already true.

action_items: FIX AuthContext: initialize useState with a lazy initializer that reads sessionStorage synchronously, e.g. `useState(() => sessionStorage.getItem('clinic_authed') === '1')`. This removes the race condition and allows refresh / direct URL access to protected routes.
Add data-testid="logout-button" to the logout control in the sidebar/layout.
Re-verify /semana (weekly grid), /nueva-cita (3-step form + slot generation respecting conflicts), /catalogo (Servicios/Especialistas tabs + CRUD modals) end-to-end after fix.
Consider adding data-testid to sidebar navigation links (agenda-link, semana-link, nueva-cita-link, catalogo-link) for future automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx: lazy-init useState from sessionStorage to avoid Protected-route redirect race condition.
server.py verify_pin: PIN is hardcoded and compared in plaintext — acceptable per product decision, but note there is no rate limiting on /api/auth/verify-pin.

server.py seed_data: sample appointments seed uses `datetime.now()` (local tz) for today while Appointment.created_at uses UTC — mixing timezones could cause 'today' mismatch for clients outside UTC. Low priority for MVP.
No /api/health endpoint; /api/ root exists which is fine.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup: 4 specialists, 6 services, 5 appointments for today. Confirmed via GET endpoints and verified visible in /agenda UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid (7/7 pytest). After main agent fixes AuthContext lazy init + adds logout-button testid, re-run frontend flow: PIN 1234 -> /agenda (verify 5 seeded appts) -> refresh page (should stay on /agenda, not redirect) -> navigate /semana (week grid with 7 columns + hours), /nueva-cita (3-step: specialist -> service -> slots; slots overlapping seeded appts should be disabled; submission redirects to /agenda), /catalogo (Servicios & Especialistas tabs, add/edit/delete modals). PIN testids are pin-key-0..9, pin-key-clear, pin-key-delete, pin-dot-0..3, pin-lock-screen.
rca of the issue: Root cause of redirect-on-refresh: AuthContext.jsx line 6 uses `useState(false)` and then reads sessionStorage inside useEffect (lines 8-11). On first render, authed=false, so <Protected> (in App.js) immediately <Navigate to='/' replace/>'s before the effect executes. Fix: `const [authed, setAuthed] = useState(() => typeof window !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage.getItem('clinic_authed') === '1');` — this synchronously seeds the correct state before first render. Reproduction: login with PIN 1234, observe /agenda loads, hit browser refresh or paste /semana into address bar — you are redirected to /.
